dialect.detail: HP-3000 (MPE/iX) COBOL with embedded DB2-style SQL (EXEC SQL), Italian retail/fashion domain. SOURCE-COMPUTER and OBJECT-COMPUTER both declare HP-3000. Uses HP-specific file commands (FILE WRITE=XESTERO.ESTERO;ACC=APPEND;SHR). Later comments suggest migration toward Linux ('conv' sections, sleep command, LINE SEQUENTIAL).

purpose.domain_detail: Italian fashion/retail chain store management system - writes movement/residual records for stores including foreign (ESTERO), MAXIMA, and outlet stores. Handles currency (EURO/LIRE conversion), store codes, and merchandise data.
purpose.summary: WRITERES is a batch subprogram in an Italian retail fashion management system that writes transaction/movement records to various output files (WRITE, DANEG, MERCFR) depending on the destination store type (foreign stores, MAXIMA, residual). It handles Euro/Lire currency conversion, extended size tables, and exclusive file access control. It has evolved over many years (1998-2018) with multiple named change sets.

notable_features: EXEC SQL with INCLUDE of SQL copybooks (CONTESTE.IF, INDNEG.IF, SQLCA)
HP-3000 MPE/iX file system commands embedded as PIC X literals
SELECT OPTIONAL with LINE SEQUENTIAL organization
Multiple REDEFINES for date and currency fields
7 COPY statements for shared data structures
Multi-year change history with named change tags (CODI, EURO, MAXIMA, ACQUO, ESTETA, REC01)
Linux migration artifacts (sleep command, conv sections)
verdict.notes: Source is truncated to first 16000 chars out of 77116 bytes / 1154 lines. The program shows clear production heritage spanning 1998-2018 with named change sets. HP-3000 origin with evidence of Linux migration ('conv' comment blocks). Italian language comments throughout. The file uses fixed format but has some free-format comment lines mixed in (lines without column 7 indicator), likely due to the HP-3000 COBOL dialect permitting this or editor artifacts.
